verdicts.reason: A reads clearly left to right in three zones (brand, can, then headline, subcopy and CTA in a centred stack) with good hierarchy, but the NEW FLAVOR pill outweighs the small SOLSTICE logo stacked under it inside the big circle, and the can sits tight against that cluster with uneven gaps.
